instruction: Change the font of all text in this document to Arial.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully exported the docx document to PDF using File > Export as PDF menu in LibreOffice Writer, keeping the original filename. Completed in 13 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can interact with LibreOffice Writer menus, navigate File menu options, use Export as PDF dialog, handle file save dialogs
metadata.task_rationale: Successful trajectory showed model can operate LibreOffice Writer menus. This variation tests font formatting capability using the same document setup.
metadata.explanation: Task requires selecting all text and changing font to Arial. Getter reads the docx file from VM and extracts font information from both style defaults and individual runs. Metric checks if default font or majority of runs match Arial.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts font information from the docx file, covering both paragraph and table runs, which aligns with the 'all text' requirement.
Metric correctly accesses expected.get('expected_font') directly from the rules dict, proper handling for type='rule'.
Postconfig properly saves the document (Ctrl+S + Enter for format dialog) before the getter reads the file.

Minor issue: Metric returns 1.0 immediately if default_font matches Arial without checking individual runs. If some runs explicitly override to a non-Arial font while the Normal style default is Arial, this would be a false positive.
The 80% threshold for run-level checking is slightly lenient for an 'all text' instruction, but reasonable in practice since structural/hidden runs may retain original fonts.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Instead of returning 1.0 immediately when default_font matches, also verify that no runs explicitly override to a different font. Check that run_fonts contains only 'inherited' or the expected font when default matches.
Consider raising the run-level threshold from 80% to 95% or higher to better match the 'all text' requirement.
